resources.string: Lets your paired Mac tap, swipe and type on this phone

Turn this on to control this phone from the Mac you have paired with Sidekick: clicking the mirrored screen taps here, dragging swipes here, and typing goes into the text field you have selected.

Sidekick does not read the screen, watch what you do, or send anything anywhere on its own. It only acts when your Mac asks it to, over the private connection between the two devices - never through the internet.

It cannot press the power or volume buttons: no app can. Turn this off here at any time and mirroring will keep working without control.
